notes: Fixed playlist shuffle issues.
Fixed songs getting duplicated when restoring the queue.
Fixed the current song position changing unexpectedly when switching shuffle on or off.
Improved support for adding the same song multiple times to a playlist.
Fixed incorrect song highlighting in the 'In Queue' playlist screen.
Improved playback stability and playlist handling.
Modular Album Artwork: Choose between Vinyl Disc, Compact Disc, Classic Cassette, and Static Card presentation styles on the Now Playing screen.
Visuals & Artwork Settings: New dedicated configuration screen to customize player aesthetics, disc animations, and visual styles.
High-Performance Embedded Art: Implemented AlaunaTagLibBitmapLoader for direct native artwork extraction without frame drops.
Refined Media Notification: Upgraded notification controls with quick Favorite toggle, Shuffle, and Repeat state synchronization.
Playback Speed & Pitch Stability: Added debouncing to pitch and speed slider adjustments to prevent playback engine crashes during rapid changes.
Settings Architecture Refactor: Modularized configuration screens and decoupled view models for faster navigation.
Opus Decoder & Tagging Stability: Resolved playback crashes and native decoder stalls during tag editing or artwork updates on Opus/Ogg streams, ensuring continuous, glitch-free audio.

Folder Exclusion Tree Revamp: Redesigned the directory exclusion picker with capped indentation, branch guidelines, and flattened list virtualization to eliminate UI truncation on deeply nested paths.
Resilient Playback Queue: Fixed queue bounds and active index tracking during playback errors, allowing seamless skipping forward or backward without desyncing playlist state.
Sound Effects & Equalizer Polish: Enhanced Equalizer and Volume tab controls with responsive DSP slider adjustments and persistent gain settings.
Clean Architecture Modernization: Decoupled UI modules, unified presentation screens/components across library, player, and settings, and upgraded the toolchain for a leaner binary footprint.
Sleep Timer UI Sync: Reopening the app now preserves and displays the active sleep timer countdown directly in the player menu without resetting.
Granular Folder Exclusions: Exclude loose songs sitting directly in parent folders without accidentally blocking their subfolders.
New Visualizer Styles: Added smooth Geiss and Modern Hi-Fi visualizer presets for the Now Playing screen.
Non-Intrusive Engine Fallback: Visualizers silently fall back to internal processing without popping up error toasts, featuring clear status banners in Settings.
Refined Music Search: Clean pill-style search bar with single-tap filter chips to quickly narrow down songs, artists, or albums.
Smart Lyrics Matcher: Refined the online lyrics search sheet to prioritize and surface versions closest to the track's actual duration.
Instant Album Art Updates: Editing tags or replacing cover art now updates player artwork and mini players immediately without stale cache delays.
Smoother Scrolling Carousel: Improved spotlight carousel scrolling and state restoration to prevent cards from appearing partially between positions when returning to the Home screen.
Asset & Storage Cleanup: Removed unused legacy graphics and streamlined app bundle resources.
Daily Mixes & Radio Stations: Algorithmic smart stations inspired by Nokia MixRadio that adapt to listening habits, dominant vibes, time of day, and catalog rediscovery.
Resilient Library Sync: Play counts, favorites, and playlists now stay linked when moving files or rescanning storage.
Multi-Copy Support: Duplicate files across different folders (e.g., Music vs. Downloads) maintain independent play counts and ratings.
Track Conflict Resolver: Easily re-link or reconcile moved audio files during backup restoration.
Redesigned Equalizer & FX: Fresh interface featuring rotary dials, bass boost, reverb, and a global bypass toggle.
Spatial Audio Controls: Added stereo widening and channel balance sliders for headphone listening.
Smoother Visualizers: Optimized rendering engine for responsive, low-latency audio visualizers.
Hardware Volume Sync: Player volume now stays directly synchronized with device media steps.
Stable Queue Reordering: Resolved crashes when dragging and dropping tracks in playlists containing duplicates.
Contextual Playlist Naming: Auto-suggests playlist names based on the current playing track or album.
In-App Diagnostics: Added a system log viewer and diagnostic export tool under Settings.
Custom Typography: Added Inter, Lexend, Open Sans, Selawik, and Work Sans font options in Appearance settings.
Hardened Backups: Improved reliability of local JSON export/import for playlists, tags, and history.
Smarter Sleep Timer: stop playback by duration, song count, end of queue, or after a specific track finishes
Custom sleep timer options with direct numeric inputs for precise minutes or track counts
Fixed sleep timer lifecycle: audio now pauses cleanly without breaking UI playback controls or closing the app
New single-tap Track Rating dialog to quickly mark songs as Liked, Disliked, or Neutral
Smoother, jitter-free queue reordering with rock-solid duplicate track handling
Faster and more responsive song lists with scoped recomposition across all library screens
Added home screen app launcher shortcuts to quickly Play, Shuffle, Search, or open Favorites
Fixed background playback stability, lifecycle bugs, and database sync edge cases
Faster, instant loading and smoother sorting in Favorites and smart playlists
Added audio pitch controls in playback settings and player dialogs
Customizable play-count thresholds (set duration percentage or time cap for played tracks)
Fixed playback queue bugs, track skipping, and timeline desync issues
